t: The career center is on the third floor.
Advisors are available for walk-in visits every afternoon.
You can schedule a mock interview through the student portal.
Please bring a printed copy of your resume to each appointment.
Workshops on cover letters are held twice a month.
Students with concerns about internships can meet an advisor in the resource room.
Employers will visit campus next month, so this is a good time to update your resume and practice introducing yourself.
